n03.roman: Ab Marine Drive dekho! Teen kilometre samandar kinara, aur peeli, gulabi, neeli Art Deco imaaratein.

n04.roman: Twist! Maana jaata hai, Miami ke baad duniya ka doosra sabse bada Art Deco collection Mumbai mein hai! 2018 mein Marine Drive ki ye imaaratein UNESCO World Heritage ka hissa baneen!

n05.roman: Raat mein lights motiyon ki maala jaisi, isiliye naam Queen's Necklace! Farak bas itna: Miami ka Deco neon, Mumbai ka shaant.

n06.roman: Toh fan theory: Vice City ka desi judwaan? Marine Drive!
